steps.name: RUN pip install --no-cache-dir uv && uv sync --frozen --no-dev

sections.heading: Licencia de los materiales de demostración

callGraph.callee:
SimpleDocTemplate(
            str(output),
            pagesize=A4,
            rightMargin=48,
            leftMargin=48,
            topMargin=48,
            bottomMargin=55,
        ).build

conn.execute(
                "SELECT d.id FROM documents d WHERE sha256=%s AND EXISTS "
                "(SELECT 1 FROM chunks c WHERE c.document_id=d.id AND embedding_model=%s)",
                (digest, model),
            ).fetchone
conn.execute("SELECT id FROM documents WHERE sha256=%s", (digest,)).fetchone

conn.execute(
                    "SELECT 1 FROM chunks WHERE document_id=%s AND embedding_model=%s LIMIT 1",
                    (doc_id, model),
                ).fetchone

conn.execute(
                "SELECT id::text,name,created_at,"
                "(SELECT count(*) FROM pages p WHERE p.document_id=d.id) AS pages "
                "FROM documents d ORDER BY created_at DESC"
            ).fetchall
